Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.effect

Enum Class EffectType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EffectType>
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.effect.EffectType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EffectType>, Constable
public enum EffectType extends Enum<EffectType>
The status effects a creature can be under, with how repeated applications combine.

Message templates use the creature as the subject: "You are poisoned." / "The imp is poisoned."

  • Enum Constant Details

    • POISONED

      public static final EffectType POISONED
      Loses magnitude HP each turn. Repeated doses add to the magnitude.

    • BURNING

      public static final EffectType BURNING
      Takes magnitude fire damage each turn. Put out by water; cannot start while wet.

    • WET

      public static final EffectType WET
      Soaked: immune to catching fire. Applying it puts out burning.

    • STUNNED

      public static final EffectType STUNNED
      Cannot act. Cannot be re-applied while already stunned.

    • SLOWED

      public static final EffectType SLOWED
      Actions take twice as long. Cancels haste.

    • HASTED

      public static final EffectType HASTED
      Actions take half as long. Cancels slow.

    • WEAKENED

      public static final EffectType WEAKENED
      Deals one third less damage.

    • SHIELDED

      public static final EffectType SHIELDED
      Absorbs up to magnitude damage before breaking.

    • REGENERATING

      public static final EffectType REGENERATING
      Regains magnitude HP each turn.

    • BLINDED

      Sight shrinks to one tile and accuracy drops.

    • CONFUSED
